new_series.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries
new_series.synopsis: Sister Boniface, Sam and Felix uncover the murderer of one of three actors shortlisted to play the next agent Jonas Best, and Sam is surprised by the return of old flame Ruth Penny.

new_series.title: Vigil
new_series.synopsis: DCI Silva and DI Longacre investigate the murder of a British citizen in the Arctic, but they soon find themselves caught in an escalating political situation.

new_series.title: Money for Nothing
new_series.synopsis: Expert upcycler Sarah Moore calls on woodworking legend Norman Wilkinson for his biggest ever challenge... a smashed-up organ.

new_series.title: The Marlow Murder Club
new_series.synopsis: When retired archaeologist Judith witnesses a murder, she teams up with vicar’s wife Becks and dog walker Suzie to investigate.

new_series.title: Schitt's Creek
new_series.synopsis: Moira believes she is the cause of a man’s death at the motel. Johnny and Stevie attempt to keep the motel guests distracted while they deal with the removal of the dead body.

new_series.title: The History Podcast
new_series.synopsis: Hidden on page 1692 of his great-grandfather Siegfried’s unpublished memoir, the writer Joe Dunthorne discovers a confession.

new_series.title: Broken Colours
new_series.synopsis: Jess meets Dan and falls in love. It changes both of their lives. But who is Dan? Holli Dempsey and Josef Altin star in a new thriller from the creator of Tracks, Matthew Broughton

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Nathan Filer explores how the language of neurodiversity has evolved – offering a sense of belonging for many, while raising difficult questions about difference and diagnosis.

new_series.title: Intrigue
new_series.synopsis: When two young men with no English and no income want to rent a flat in San Diego, an Arabic-speaking neighbour offers help.

new_series.title: Unspeakable
new_series.synopsis: Phil Wang and Susie Dent challenge guests to invent new words and help create the new ultimate Unspeakable dictionary. With guests Jessie Cave, Armando Iannucci and Chloe Petts.

new_series.title: A Working Mother by Agnes Owens
new_series.synopsis: Ten years after the Second World War, Betty is married to a troubled veteran who barely looks after their two children while she earns a wage.

new_series.title: You Do Not Have to Say Anything
new_series.synopsis: From high-octane car chases (rare) to being arrested lying in your own bed (common), arrests mean the same thing - a shift from person to suspect, ordinary citizen to ‘the accused’
